summary.text: Chuck Moseley (Charles Moseley on Ballotpedia) is a Democratic member of the Indiana House of Representatives who has represented District 10 since 2008 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Moseley served in the Army National Guard.
He took office in the Indiana House in 2008 and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
